recovered_alignment: One tiny shared Fold/Bloom semantic kernel; LIVE, Two Dial and Ecology remain unequal projections/adapters rather than duplicated sovereign apps.
The central ring should visibly change when game mode changes; mode meaning should not live only in labels/panels.
Hexagram/trigram grammar is useful as a state/change language when treated as formal projection, not decorative mysticism.
Six sectors are a carrier, not a universal ontology; projection cannot increase authority.
delta: PUZZLE becomes FORM → CHANGE instead of ending after six-line construction.
FORM still asks for an exact reachable six-line target.
After a correct FORM, ring rotation modulo six addresses line 1–6.
A CHANGE release overwrites the addressed line with the consequence bit: BLOOM/FOLD solid; SPLIT/RETURN broken.
Clear when two final line positions differ from the formed state, within four CHANGE releases.
Result is emitted as exact H[A] Δ{…} → H[B] state language.
Renderer gains one bounded gameProjection aperture; modes alter the central ring itself.

HEX uses inner=lower trigram and outer=upper trigram sectors; TWO DIAL shows two six-position relation dials; ECOLOGY shows generation rings; RUN/PATH show bounded progress witnesses; ZEN adds nothing.
LIVE module chain is revision-pinned so phone caches cannot silently preserve the old renderer/play graph.
